subject: *: reset infoschema v2 data before a full load (#54831)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Main change: when infoschema v2 is enabled, `Builder.InitWithDBInfos` now calls `Data.resetBeforeFullLoad(schemaVersion)` to tomb MVCC indexes (byID/byName/schemaMap/schemaID2Name/pid2tid/tableInfoResident) at the target schema version before rebuilding from meta, preventing stale table/DB mappings after fallback to full reload while preserving historical versions; tests add a domain failpoint to force diff-load failure paths. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency, concurrency, or state-machine handling within the scoped infoschema changes; later history shows further infoschema v2 evolution but no follow-up changes specifically to `resetBeforeFullLoad`.
